text: Ronnie and Nilay looked after us from the first email to the day we collected the keys. We flew out with a shortlist already agreed, saw six properties in two days and never once felt pushed towards something outside our budget. The legal side was handled by our own solicitor, exactly as they had explained on the phone weeks earlier.

We had been let down by another agent before we found Coast 2 Coast. The difference was obvious within a week. Every question got a straight answer, including the ones about costs that other agents had avoided. Nilay dealt with the paperwork and the tapu transfer went through without a single surprise.

Genuinely the most straightforward property purchase I have made, and I have bought three houses in the UK. They talked me out of one villa because the deed was not clean, which cost them a sale and earned my trust completely. I have already recommended them to two friends in Ireland.
